This beta makes UsageDeck downloads easier to verify and temporarily removes OpenCode Go until it has a safe, authoritative usage source.

## Improvements

- Every release now includes `SHA256SUMS.txt`, listing the SHA-256 checksum for each installer, portable package, update package and release-feed file.

## Changes

- OpenCode Go no longer appears in setup, Settings or usage tabs. Existing selections are disabled automatically, while any stored Console service-account key remains on the PC for a possible return.
